events.title: US-Iran ceasefire EXPIRED — Hormuz stalemate, no negotiations
events.summary: 60-day ceasefire deadline expired Aug 16. Both sides at impasse. Iran FM: no negotiations. IRGC striking ships. Kushner meeting Hamas in Cairo, Netanyahu in Israel Aug 17. 8-nation coalition condemns Israel Gaza plan rejection.

events.title: Ebola deadliest in DRC history — 2,325 deaths, surpassing 2018-2020
events.summary: Ebola outbreak killed 2,325 people (Aug 16 gov data), surpassing 2018-2020 outbreak as deadliest in DRC history. Bundibugyo strain, no approved treatments. Deaths outside known transmission chains. WHO says on pace to eclipse 2014-2016 (11,000 deaths).

events.title: Kushner meets Hamas leadership in Cairo, lands in Israel Aug 17
events.summary: Jared Kushner met Hamas leadership in Cairo with Qatar/Egypt/Turkey officials. Landed in Israel Monday to meet Netanyahu. Accompanied by Mladenov and Tony Blair. Working to advance Gaza ceasefire plan rejected by Israel. 8 nations condemn Israeli rejection.

events.title: USS Abraham Lincoln morale crisis — CENTCOM chief visits, 260+ days deployed
events.summary: CENTCOM chief Brad Cooper visited USS Lincoln amid reports of food shortages, broken plumbing, mental health crises. Sailor went overboard earlier this month. 260+ days at sea, 10,000 aircraft flights, 1.5M lbs ordnance expended. Ship preparing to return to US.

events.title: Yen intervention unraveling — USD/JPY at 159.32, half gains erased
events.summary: Joint US-Japan 88B intervention unraveling. USD/JPY back to 159.32 from 155 intervention low. US ESF sold euros (first since 1998). BOJ supporting faster rate hikes (Sept/Oct). JGB 10Y at 2.8%, 30Y near 4%. Sen. Warren demanding justification.

events.title: Oil at 88.52 — Hormuz closure keeps prices elevated, SPR at multi-decade low
events.summary: Brent at 88.52, up from prior week. EIA forecasts elevated prices until Hormuz flows normalize. Global inventories drew down sharply. SPR at 304.8 mbbl (multi-decade low). Hormuz: 20% of global oil/LNG normally transits.

events.title: China 148B property time bomb — PBOC eases, deflation war faltering
events.summary: Beijing eased property purchase restrictions Aug 7 (3rd time). 148B in property leases expiring. PBOC pledges timely new policy rollout. Deflation war faltering in real time. Stable currency to avoid devaluation tensions with Washington.
